0.0: Thank you for all your help so far. After all this time in the castle, I nearly lost hope... It's all thanks to you that I didn't.

yes.0: My heart is heavy, but I know I chose the right path. My loyalty has never changed, not even for a moment.
yes.1: I hope my king finds peace.
